purpose: Teach: 劣っ/裏返し/裏腹/正しかっ/小柄/可愛らしい/起っ/つくれ

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さんが体格で劣っても精神力で勝負された
lines.en: Gran — when Father was young, he'd win through sheer will even if he lacked the physique for it.
lines.style: Soft, reverent opening. Voice settles into memory. Slow, deliberate pacing. The warmth of someone recalling a quality they deeply admired. Trailing slightly into reflection.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: うん、お祖父ちゃん、お孫様のシャツが裏返しでもニコニコされたわよね、あなた?
lines.en: Yes — and Grandfather, you'd smile so wide even when Grandson had his shirt on inside-out, didn't you, dear?
lines.style: Warm chuckle underneath. Gentle tease with affection. Quick, almost musical rhythm. The knowing tone of someone who watched a thousand small kindnesses unfold. Slight upturn at the question.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さんは厳しい姿勢と裏腹に深い愛情をお持ちだった
lines.en: Gran — when Father was young, beneath that strict exterior ran a love so deep it shaped everything he did.
lines.style: Quieter this time. Voice carries the weight of understanding long-held. Measured pace, each word distinct. The ache of recognizing someone's hidden tenderness only after time has passed.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: お祖父ちゃん、「正しかった」と過去を振り返られたわよね、あなた?
lines.en: Grandfather — you always looked back at what was right, didn't you, dear? At the choices you made.
lines.style: Soft agreement. Not a question really, more a confirmation wrapped in affection. Gentle rhythm. The comfort of two people who lived through the same truth together.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さんは小柄でも村のリーダーだった
lines.en: Gran — when Father was young, though he was small in stature, he was the one the village turned to.
lines.style: Voice steadies with quiet pride. Deliberate pacing. The kind of respect that doesn't need volume. Eyes almost distant, seeing across decades.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: お祖父ちゃん、お孫様を可愛らしいと頬ずりされたわよね、あなた?
lines.en: Grandfather — and you'd nuzzle Grandson's cheek and tell him he was precious, didn't you, dear?
lines.style: Tender warmth flooding in. Slower tempo. Voice dips slightly on the remembrance of physical affection. The safety of recalling something gentle without self-consciousness.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さんと共に大事件が起った夜があった
lines.en: Gran — when Father was young, there was a night when a great crisis came, and he faced it.
lines.style: Voice drops slightly lower. The opening is careful, building toward something significant. Slower cadence. The weight of a memory that still holds importance. Pause before the final phrase.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: お祖父ちゃん、お孫様にお手玉をつくれるよう教えて下さったわよね、あなた?
lines.en: Grandfather — and you taught Grandson how to make otedama with those patient hands of yours, didn't you, dear?
lines.style: Voice brightens gently. Warm, almost liquid quality. Slow, careful delivery as if describing something fragile and precious. Soft fadeout on the final affection.
